limits: New typed C++ ownership/storage API, not an original object overlay, vtable or drop-in binary ABI.
Construction consumes explicit positive reference count, byte44 and actual already-retained owner fields; this packet does not infer native constructors/default identities.
Every traversed child and nonnull+A0 owner needs an actual runtime association; missing associations terminate instead of falling back to no-op dispatch.
Terminal destructor covers the hierarchy-cleared path after virtual18. General direct destruction, reparent/animation paths and terminal callbacks that rebuild dying hierarchy or scene are excluded.
Native physical model pool layout/critical section and diagnostic size-class allocator remain outside; required real storage owner and supplied memory_resource perform actual host storage disposal.
No claim for corrupt/negative arrays, byte overflow, allocation failure or Win32 exception unwinding.
